tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find events in Germany: concerts, parties, club nights, festivals, open airs, workshops, markets or community events, in a city or near them, for a day, a weekend or a date range. Returns upcoming public events with date, venue, price and a wullup.com link. Do not use it for buying tickets, for events outside Germany, or for past events.

query.description: Words to match in the event title or venue, e.g. 'Techno', 'Jazz', 'Flohmarkt'. Omit for everything.

city.description: Only when the user explicitly named a German city or town, e.g. München, Köln, Frankfurt am Main (English names like Munich or Cologne work too). Omit to use the user's approximate location.

when.description: A quick date window. Ignored when `from` is given.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (German local date).

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (German local date).

language.description: The language the user writes in: 'de' for German, 'en' for any other language. Sets the language of the event cards.
